title: wk-ytad-watchdog: external log-staleness auto-restart for wk-ytad
desc: Repo-root pace-exempt sibling of wk-ytad.cmd. Detects the alive-but-hung death (process alive, log heartbeat stopped, step 12 of the daemon own skill) via .tmp/wk-ytad/wk-ytad.pid plus wk-ytad.log LastWriteTime staleness, then restarts the daemon via its own -Stop verb plus a detached relaunch.
steps: WHAT: reads wk-ytad.pid plus wk-ytad.log LastWriteTime every -IntervalSec (default 60s); a log untouched beyond -StaleSec (default 180s, about 90x the normal ~2s write cadence) while the pid is still alive is the alive-but-hung signature

USAGE: wk-ytad-watchdog.cmd loop mode foreground; -Once single check for a Scheduled Task repeat trigger; -Status read-only report exit 0 healthy exit 1 otherwise; -NoAutoStart skip relaunch when simply not running

LAUNCH: must be started the same way as wk-ytad.cmd itself, a user-opened terminal or a Windows Scheduled Task repeat trigger, never an AI harness shell tool call, since AI-session-parented processes get reaped when the session process tree is torn down
SEE ALSO: wk-ytad-zero-cpu-uia-youtube-ad-skip-daemon-for-edge step 12 is the root cause this tool fixes
author: claude
